title: Dombrava, Kozlovskis survive no confidence vote in Latvian parliament
summary_full: On Thursday, 3 September, Jānis Dombrava, Minister for the Interior (National Alliance), and Rihards Kozlovskis, Minister for Transport (New Unity), survived a vote of no confidence tabled by the opposition party Latvia First and several MPs not affiliated with any parliamentary group.
